writer.name: Claude Opus 5.5, the hypnosis guide lane's writer (the splices and their fixes; the words are Emulate's)

findings.label: D9 follows the source order
examples: 1/1 paragraphs follow the source's points in its order (agreement 1.00); fine if each part notices something; check T13 and T09 in the tell ledger
findings.reason: It is Emulate's rewrite of the line it replaces, so it follows that line's points in order by design (no warmth today, hands there, notice, no faking); the turns are Emulate's ("If you can't do this in a loving way today", "just", "see what you feel"), the last three words his.

findings.label: E36/E41 heavy second person
findings.reason: The "you"s are the reader doing the practice the paragraph gives ("If you can't do this", "your hands", "what you feel"): one fallback step inside the practice, not a run of coaching lines.
